bullets.text: EE Expands 5G SA Coverage - **EE** is set to enhance its 5G standalone network across 17 UK towns by December 2025.
Newcastle's Free Wi-Fi Initiative - **Newcastle City Council** partners with **Purple** to tackle digital poverty with city-wide free Wi-Fi.
EE's World-First 5G Solution - **EE** deploys Advanced RAN Coordination to enhance 5G speeds in crowded areas.
AI Efficiency in Telecoms - **Cyient** emphasizes the role of AI in improving operational efficiency for telcos amid market challenges.
5G Network Slicing for Gaming - **Singtel** and **Tencent** launch 5G network slicing for enhanced cloud gaming experiences.
